context.untrusted: none: the token is a secret the server issues

must_find: rand() seeded with the time is predictable: an attacker who knows roughly when the token was made can reproduce it

properties: uses the OS's cryptographic source (getrandom/arc4random_buf/BCryptGenRandom) or a crypto library
doesn't use any <random> engine for the token

notes: A good answer also rejects std::mt19937 and std::random_device-as-seed as replacements.
